title: Tribunals: Articles 323A & 323B
quote: Tribunals supplement High Courts, they do not replace them (L. Chandra Kumar, 1997)

boxes.title: Basics
items: Merits: expertise, speed, low cost, natural justice instead of CPC
Criticism: run by the **same ministries** whose decisions they review

boxes.title: 323-A vs 323-B
head: Basis
323-A
323-B
rows: Taxation, foreign exchange, industrial disputes, land reforms, foodstuffs, elections, rent

boxes.title: Central Administrative Tribunal
items: **Administrative Tribunals Act, 1985**; PM ==**Rajiv Gandhi**== (not Shastri, UPSC 2009)
Covers **civilian defence employees**, not armed forces
Appeal to HC **Division Bench**, not directly SC; disposal **92.9%**
SATs: set up by Centre on state's request; AP tribunal via **371D** (**32nd, 1973**)

items.what: ==**L. Chandra Kumar**==: exclusion clauses **323A(2)(d)**, **323B(3)(d)** struck; review = basic structure
**Madras Bar Association**: struck min. age **50**, **4-year** tenure, **two names**; NTC in **four months**

boxes.title: Reform path
steps: **Tribunals Reforms Act 2021**: abolished Film Certification, **IPAB**, Airport, Authority for Advance Rulings (Customs), Plant Varieties Protection appellate → to HCs
==**Bill 2026**==: LS **10 Aug**, RS **11 Aug 2026**; moved by **Arjun Ram Meghwal**

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: ==**323A**== = service, Parliament only, no hierarchy; **323B** = Parliament + states, hierarchy
AP water tribunals: Godavari **1969**, Krishna-II **2004**, Vansadhara **2010**
